title: CONFIGURATION.md schema does not match the configuration kbs init writes
description: The schema section shows project_key as 2 to 6 uppercase letters, issue_types, workflow_bindings and a priorities list, while init writes a lowercase key, types, a priorities map and many sections the page does not describe. Regenerate the reference from the real model.
